what_this_is: Receipt for data/v4/corpus-v4-r3.jsonl (ledger item C-10): the working corpus with C-7's triage-format family and C-8's triage-refusal family folded in, and the refusal share re-solved onto the policy target.

rules.format: the parent's 2,600 presentations unchanged; the new triage-format family enters at the stream's existing weight x2
rules.refusal: the parent's 1,198 distinct rows and C-8's 144 distinct rows pooled into 1,342 distinct rows, presented at a uniform round-robin weight so no refusal family is over-represented
rules.share: solved against the FINAL denominator: R / (non_refusal_mass + R) = target

policy.note: the policy's invariant is the SHARE, so adding families re-solves the presentation count rather than moving the share

contamination_scan.note: measured with the reference detectors, imported

not_the_final_corpus: this is the working corpus. Phase D's removals (D-3, D-4, D-5) and D-7's Data Gate receipt produce data/v4/corpus-final.jsonl, and no training is valid before that receipt exists.
